rss.title: RSS Reader
rss.noFeeds: No feeds configured. Add a feed URL to get started.

error.invalidUrl: Please enter a valid feed URL
error.feedExists: This feed has already been added

success.backfillQueued: Backfill queued: the newest cached items will be published over the next sync cycles, using this feed's post status.

widget.title: Public Page
widget.description: View aggregated RSS feeds on the public page

publish.title: Publish to site
publish.contentHint: Available: title, link, description, content, author, sourceTitle. Write each one in double braces, as shown below.
publish.linkPropertyHint: Discovery property carrying the item URL, e.g. bookmark-of. Leave empty for a plain note or article.
publish.dateSourceHint: The item's own date is accurate but sorts the post into the past, where a feed of older items produces posts nobody sees.

settings.title: Feed settings
settings.urlHint: Correcting this keeps the cached items; removing and re-adding the feed would lose them.

backfill.label: Publish existing items
backfill.hint: How many of the newest cached items to publish. They are created with this feed's post status, a few per sync cycle.

republish.hint: Clears what this feed has published so the current settings apply to every item again. Existing posts are overwritten, not duplicated.
